children: Digital Brands Group executed a binding contract guaranteeing $3.3 million in cash flow from Sept 1–Dec 31, 2026.
$3.3 million in guaranteed cash flow covers the U.S. Program from Sept 1 through Dec 31, 2026, providing near-term revenue certainty.
The $3.3M represents receipts from the first two markets of a larger $165 million U.S. Program planned over the next two years.
Company expects guaranteed cash flow to increase significantly each quarter over the next two years per CEO statement.
Details of the broader $165M initiative were previously disclosed in the Form 8-K filed July 27, 2026.
